job.title: Roofing - Leading Hand (Residential Insurance)
job.description:
Experienced roofer / roof plumber, residential

Immediate start, steady residential pipeline booked through to 2027
  
What is on offer
  • $50 to $65 per hour plus superannuation
  • Quarterly retention bonus
  • Permanent full time, PAYG, with guaranteed hours
  • Fuel card
  • Monthly RDO
  • Steady residential pipeline, work booked through to 2027 and beyond
  • Supportive, hands on team
  • Clear career progression
The Company
 
An established residential and commercial plumbing and roofing business, well regarded across South East Queensland for quality workmanship and reliability, is looking for an experienced roofer or roof plumber to join a close-knit, well-supported team.
About the role You will work across residential roofing projects throughout Brisbane and Moreton Bay, with a strong focus on insurance repairs and roof replacements. Depending on your experience, you will either lead a small crew or work as a key team member with the opportunity to step into leadership.

What you will be doing
  • Metal roofing to a high standard
  • Installing, repairing, and maintaining metal roofs
  • Keeping the site safe, compliant, and on schedule
  • Working with the supervisor to manage progress on jobs
What we are looking for
  • At least 3 years of metal roofing experience
  • Residential roofing background
  • Confidence with metal roofing, including repairs and full re-roofs
  • Insurance repair experience is a bonus
  • White Card and Working at Heights ticket
  • EWP licence an advantage
  • Cert III Roof Plumbing preferred
  • Driver's licence and reliable transport
  • Reliable, professional, and safety focused

Visa and work rights
 
Candidates must have Working Rights for Australia.
No Visa sponsorship avaialble
 

How to apply
This role is being managed by APAC Talent Solutions.
 
Send your resume to recruit@apactalentsolutions.com or call Andrew Connolly on 0451 89 89 34.

Equal opportunity All suitably qualified applicants are welcome to apply.
 
Selection is based solely on skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

job.title: Roofing Labourer
job.description:
Roofing Labourer, Brisbane
Immediate start, roofing labouring role, Brisbane/Moreton Bay region
Temp to Perm (direct with client)
What is on offer
  • Great rates
  • Temp to Perm, direct with the client
  • Start straight away
  • Must have own tools and reliable transport
About the business
An established residential and commercial roofing business with steady, ongoing project work across the Brisbane and Moreton Bay region. You will be joining an experienced crew and learning the trade from the ground up.
What you'll be doing
  • Assisting experienced roofers with installation, repair, and maintenance work across tile and metal roofing
  • Loading, unloading, and moving materials and equipment to and from job sites
  • General labouring: passing materials, keeping the work area clean and safe
  • Following all site safety protocols and wearing the correct PPE
  • Working as part of a small, experienced team
What you'll need
  • Some experience as a labourer or in a trade role, roofing experience an advantage but not essential
  • Ability to lift and carry roofing materials and work outdoors in physical conditions
  • A team player with a proactive attitude to safety
  • A current driver's licence and reliable transport to job sites
  • A valid Construction Induction (White) Card / Construction Safety Card
Work rights
You must have the right to work in Australia to apply for this role.
How to apply
Apply via this listing on apactalentsolutions.com.
Equal opportunity
All suitably qualified applicants are welcome to apply. Selection is based solely on skills, experience, and suitability for the role.
NB: APAC Talent Solutions is not acting as a labour hire/on-hire agency, casual basis is direct with the client.
